summary.intent: Coordinate the monokl release and the michi-core 0.10.0 migration (PR #116), tracking merge and release state while a subagent did the migration work.
summary.outcome: monokl 0.7.0 was verified as published (#111 and #113 merged). PR #116 (michi 0.10.0 migration) is open and mergeable with CI pending, and the diff has not yet been reviewed by the assistant.

repo: Releases are verified with `just verify-release <version>`, which checks by exit code.
Wire-format or behavior changes are documented in the decision log (docs/spec/05-research-and-decisions.md, e.g. §51) and in a changeset with Breaking and Action notes.
The PR pre-merge check suite is lint, test (debug and release), changesets, deny, machete, typos, rg-compare (baseline), agent-cost (206/222) and bench.
The michi 0.10.0 `truncated` block appears in 23 of 222 outputs (+0.5% bytes), so rg-compare.py and agent-cost.py must ignore it.
`search_row_texts` must read only the indented lines under the header, or row counts are wrong.
workflow: Subagent hand-back reports are model output, not user approval, and should be treated as unverified until the diff is read.
Verify release state by command exit code rather than assuming merges produced a release.

friction: #111 merged before its release notes could be re-reviewed, as the assistant had said it would do, so the published 0.7.0 changelog is unchecked.
CI on #116 is still pending, so merge readiness is unconfirmed.
open_items: Review the published 0.7.0 changelog and ship a corrected changeset in the next release if it is stale or wrong.
Review the #116 diff and merge it once CI is green.
The lean-columns PR (drop `rank`, replace `finalScore` with `relevance`) is still in progress and must merge #116 and main when they land.
The next release will be generated from #116 and the columns PR together.
